title: H3-SHOWCASE-BMX-8s
prompt:
Ultra-photoreal cinematic 8-second shot, MiniMax Hailuo quality. Golden hour in a red-rock desert BMX dirt park. A skilled rider in a dusty jersey and full-face helmet launches a steep dirt berm, pulls a clean backflip mid-air, bike tires catching warm sunlight, then sticks the landing in a soft spray of orange dust. Low tracking camera follows from the side then swings slightly ahead as they land. Natural motion blur on wheels, sharp rider detail, volumetric god rays, lens flare restrained, shallow depth of field on distant crowd cheering. No logos, no text overlays, no cartoon, no CGI look — real documentary sports cinematography, 24fps feel, anamorphic subtle.

Avoid: still-hold, Lego, anime, war, gore, waifu, text, watermark, shaky junk, morphing face/helmet, cartoon, cgi plastic.
